entry.content: • (Cloud Services) Removed gcloud beta services mcp enable, gcloud beta services mcp disable, and gcloud beta services mcp list as MCP enablement is no longer required and they have been functioning as no-ops.
entry.summary: The `gcloud beta services mcp enable`, `gcloud beta services mcp disable`, and `gcloud beta services mcp list` commands have been removed. MCP enablement is no longer necessary for these operations, and the commands have been functioning as no-ops.
entry.title: Breaking Changes: MCP enablement commands removed

entry.content:
• Added gcloud beta ai semantic-governance-policy-engine deprovision command to tear down a semantic governance policy engine, including its tenant project, GKE cluster, and PSC service attachments.
  • Promoted gcloud ai semantic-governance-policies (create, describe, update, delete, list) and gcloud ai semantic-governance-policy-engine (describe, update, deprovision) commands from beta to GA.
entry.summary: Key commands for managing AI semantic governance policies and policy engines have been promoted to General Availability. This includes commands for creating, describing, updating, deleting, and listing policies, as well as describing, updating, and deprovisioning policy engines. A new command, `gcloud beta ai semantic-governance-policy-engine deprovision`, is also available to facilitate the teardown of policy engine resources.
entry.title: AI Platform: AI Governance Policy Engine Now Generally Available

entry.content:
• Added fields precedence and condition to the commands bq ls --reservation_assignment and bq show --reservation_assignment output.
  • Added the new AUTOMATIC_MATERIALIZED_VIEW_REFRESH job type for users to create reservation assignments with.
entry.summary: We've enhanced reservation assignments in BigQuery by adding `precedence` and `condition` fields to `bq ls` and `bq show` commands. Additionally, a new `AUTOMATIC_MATERIALIZED_VIEW_REFRESH` job type is now available for creating reservation assignments.
entry.title: BigQuery: Reservation assignment updates in BigQuery

entry.content: • Enabled Enterprise Certificate Proxy (ECP) HTTP Proxy by default for context-aware mTLS requests.
entry.summary: Enterprise Certificate Proxy (ECP) HTTP Proxy is now enabled by default for context-aware mTLS requests. This update improves the security and efficiency of mutual TLS authentication processes.
entry.title: Cloud Auth: Enhanced Certificate Proxy for Secure Access

entry.content: • Rebuilt cbt cli with newer version of bigtable client for CVE-2026-39883.
entry.summary: The Cloud Bigtable CLI has been rebuilt with an updated client library to address CVE-2026-39883. This update ensures enhanced security for your Bigtable interactions. We recommend updating to the latest version.
entry.title: Cloud Bigtable: Bigtable CLI Updated

entry.content:
• Updated gcloud iam workforce-pools create-cred-config and gcloud iam workforce-pools create-login-config to accept short-format provider audiences (<pool>/<provider>).
  • Added gcloud beta iam workforce-pools providers create-saml and gcloud beta iam workforce-pools providers update-saml commands.
entry.summary: New commands are available for creating and updating SAML providers within workforce pools. Additionally, commands for creating credential and login configurations now support short-format provider audiences for easier management.
entry.title: Cloud IAM: Workforce Pool IAM Updates

entry.content: • API Keys: Added --append flag to gcloud services api-keys update command to merge new application and API target restrictions with existing key restrictions instead of replacing them.
entry.summary: The gcloud services api-keys update command now supports an --append flag. This allows you to merge new restrictions with existing ones instead of overwriting them entirely.
entry.title: Cloud Services: Update API key restrictions

entry.content:
• Fixed gcloud cluster-director clusters create to not create default compute resources when they are overridden by the user.
  • Updated gcloud cluster-director clusters create to default to hyperdisk-balanced boot disks and restrict persistent disks (PD) for non-N2 and non-CT5P machine types.
  • Fixed a validation error during cluster updates that concurrently modified storage resources and Slurm node sets.
entry.summary: This update addresses issues with cluster creation and updates, including fixes for default resource creation and storage validation. It also refines boot disk defaults for improved performance and compatibility.
entry.title: Cluster Director: Cluster Director Improvements

entry.content:
• Added gcloud compute target-ssl-proxies test-iam-permissions command to test IAM permissions on a Compute Engine target SSL proxy in beta, preview, and GA.
  • Added --max-stream-duration flag to gcloud compute backend-services create and update commands in beta, preview, and GA.
  • Added gcloud compute packet-mirrorings test-iam-permissions command for beta, preview and GA tracks.
entry.summary: Compute Engine now supports testing IAM permissions for target SSL proxies and packet mirrorings. Additionally, a new flag for managing stream duration in backend services has been introduced.
entry.title: Compute Engine: New Compute Engine Features

entry.content: • Fixed issue where gcloud CLI would crash on corrupted ~/.kube/config. Now you will now get a more detailed explanation about which section and line is wrong, to make troubleshooting easier. Corrupted kubeconfig will be backed up for further troubleshooting.
entry.summary: The gcloud CLI no longer crashes when encountering a corrupted kubeconfig file. The corrupted file will be backed up, and more detailed error information will be provided to aid in troubleshooting.
entry.title: Container: CLI crash fixed

entry.content:
• Added --reserved-public-ip and --reserved-public-ip-nat-ips-count flags to gcloud database-migration private-connections create.
  • Added --fetch-reserved-public-ips flag to gcloud database-migration connection-profiles fetch-static-ips.
entry.summary: Enhance your private connectivity configurations with new flags for creating private connections and fetching reserved public IP addresses. These additions offer greater control over your network setup during database migrations.
entry.title: Database Migration: New options for private connectivity

entry.content: • Add --enable-slice-controller flag in gcloud container clusters create and gcloud container clusters update.
entry.summary: Kubernetes Engine now supports the slice controller. Enable it during cluster creation or update using the `--enable-slice-controller` flag in gcloud commands.
entry.title: Kubernetes Engine: Slice Controller Enabled for Clusters

entry.content:
• Added --total-vm-storage-size-gb flag to gcloud oracle-database cloud-exadata-infrastructures configure-exascale and --properties-vm-backup-storage-type, --properties-vm-file-system-storage-type flags to gcloud oracle-database cloud-vm-clusters create to support Exascale VM storage options.

Subscribe to these release notes at https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/google-cloud-sdk-announce.
entry.summary: New flags have been added to gcloud oracle-database commands to support Exascale VM storage options. These updates include `--total-vm-storage-size-gb` for infrastructure configuration and `--properties-vm-backup-storage-type` and `--properties-vm-file-system-storage-type` for VM cluster creation. This enhances the flexibility for managing storage in Exascale environments.
entry.title: Oracle Database: Oracle Database Exascale Storage Options
